description: This file contains SQL schema and functions related to Orleans grain persistence, specifically for Oracle database. It defines a storage table 'ORLEANSSTORAGE', associated indexes, and stored procedures/functions for writing, reading, and clearing grain state data.

methods.name: WriteToStorage
methods.description: A PL/SQL function that inserts or updates grain state data into the ORLEANSSTORAGE table, managing concurrency via optimistic version checks.

methods.name: ClearStorage
methods.description: A PL/SQL function that clears (sets to NULL) the payload for a specific grain state entry in the database, updating the version and timestamp.
